source_caption:
Jonathan Banks almost wasn’t able to play Mike Ehrmantraut in Breaking Bad, but when another actor became unavailable, he stepped in at the last minute—creating a character so iconic that it became central to Better Call Saul.

Better Call Saul (2015–2022), created by Vince Gilligan & Peter Gould, starring Bob Odenkirk, Rhea Seehorn, Jonathan Banks. A masterfully crafted prequel that explores the slow transformation of a struggling lawyer into the morally compromised Saul Goodman, blending character study with tension and dark humor.

#BetterCallSaul #JonathanBanks #MikeEhrmantraut #PrestigeTV #ModernClassic

source_details.synopsis: Better Call Saul is an American neo-noir legal crime drama television series created by Vince Gilligan and Peter Gould for AMC. Part of the Breaking Bad franchise, it is a spin-off of Gilligan's previous series, Breaking Bad (2008–2013), to which it serves primarily as a prequel, with some scenes taking place during and after the events of Breaking Bad. Better Call Saul premiered on AMC on February 8, 2015, and ended on August 15, 2022, after six seasons, totaling 63 episodes.
